summary: The isolated v11 adapter and one-A100 micro worker fail closed on transport corruption, stale or reused allocation lifetimes, destination bit mismatches, incomplete mappings, invalid production-gate evidence, and unsafe cleanup. The real-A100 8/8 result remains a runtime gate and is not asserted by this offline review.

whole_state_sha256.evidence: Capture hashes every canonical payload byte in deterministic chunk order and commits the digest into the immutable manifest; streaming preflight recomputes and compares the whole-state digest.

per_page_sha256.evidence: Capture commits one SHA-256 per canonical page; preflight and consumption-time authentication recompute each bounded page digest with exact range-closure checks.

manifest_commitment.evidence: A domain-separated SHA-256 covers manifest.canonical_bytes(); verified-transport, destination-write, and scrub evidence bind the same commitment.

consumption_time_authentication.evidence: Every restore chunk is copied into an owned bounded snapshot and page-authenticated immediately before H2D/native consumption. NumPy alias mutation that bypasses the PyTorch version counter is rejected.

bfloat16_raw_bit_comparison.evidence: Destination validation compares int16 views, preserving NaN payload and signed-zero distinctions, and covers every logical destination byte.

partial_tail_zero_proof.evidence: Only partial-page tails are zero-filled; every tail is raw-zero validated, logical-plus-tail byte coverage must equal selected physical-page bytes, and full pages skip redundant zero fill.

destination_mapping_device_epoch_commitm.evidence: The destination target binds tensor data pointers, shapes, strides, dtype, geometry, exact CUDA index and GPU UUID. The mapping commitment additionally binds ordered logical-page destinations and allocator-issued block epochs. The production stager independently recomputes and checks sealed evidence.

failure_scrub_typed_teardown.evidence: Write failure triggers raw-zero scrub with completion fencing. Scrub, free, cache-reset, or admission-cleanup uncertainty escalates to V11RuntimeTeardownRequired with affected allocation IDs; forged or incomplete evidence is rejected.

admission_ordering.evidence: The production IMPORT_ADMISSION critical section covers transport verification, allocation, write, integrity, block-table construction, epoch validation and single-use consumption. The gate is rechecked before and between enqueue operations.

fresh_allocation_lifetimes.evidence: Runtime-issued epochs are monotonic and tombstoned after free. The micro worker requires 1,152 destination blocks and rejects intersection between source and destination (physical block ID, allocation epoch) lifetimes; reuse of a physical ID is valid only with a later epoch.

continuation_oracle_methodology.evidence: The micro worker requires exactly eight branches, at least eight continuation tokens per branch, then drains/reset-prefix-cache and independently prefills the immutable token histories using the exact original effective seed. It requires equality of all eight first resumed tokens and fails closed otherwise.

cases: missing duplicated or reordered payload ranges
BF16 NaN payload and signed-zero raw-bit preservation
physical block reuse with a later epoch

non_blocking_observations: The review proves offline control flow and CPU-fixture equivalence only; it does not convert projected amplification or continuation behavior into a measured result.
Physical block IDs may repeat only across distinct allocator epochs. The worker records physical-ID overlap separately and treats allocation lifetime as the authoritative freshness identity.

The independent oracle intentionally uses the same retained model engine after finished restored requests and a successful prefix-cache reset; this preserves identical runtime/model semantics while forcing KV recomputation.
